c8.issue: `getSecretPayload` hardcodes `Accept: application/octet-stream`, so non-octet-stream secrets still fail with 406
c8.title: Reveal Payload fails for secrets whose content type isn't `application/octet-stream`
c8.explanation:
A user who stores a secret as `text/plain` (the common case for passwords and API keys created via the CLI) and clicks Reveal Payload gets the generic `Key Manager get secret payload failed` error instead of the value. The CR1 fix replaced the default Accept header with a hardcoded one:

[[code:packages/aurora/src/server/KeyManager/routers/keyManagerRouter.ts | headers: { Accept: "application/octet-stream" } | 1]]

Barbican only serves the payload in one of the secret's `content_types`; anything else is answered with `406 Not Acceptable`, which `mapKmError` turns into an `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR`. Only opaque (octet-stream) secrets work. No test covers a non-octet-stream secret. Reference: [Barbican secrets API — GET /v1/secrets/{uuid}/payload](https://docs.openstack.org/barbican/latest/api/reference/secrets.html#get-secrets-uuid-payload): "you must set the accept header to one of the values listed in the `content_types` attribute of a secret's metadata".
c8.fix: Fetch the secret's metadata first (or accept its content type as input from the client, which already reads `secret.content_types` in [[at:packages/aurora/src/client/routes/_auth/projects/$projectId/authorization/key-manager/secrets/-components/SecretDetailsView.tsx:51]]) and send `content_types.default` as the Accept header; add a router test for a `text/plain` secret.

c1.issue: Icon-only `moreVert` row-action toggles have a `title` but no `aria-label`
c1.title: Row-action toggles lack an `aria-label`
c1.explanation: Screen-reader users get an unreliable name for the row-action button in every Key Manager list row, since `title` is only a fallback. The toggle is `<Button icon="moreVert" title={t`Secret actions`} />` at [[at:packages/aurora/src/client/routes/_auth/projects/$projectId/authorization/key-manager/secrets/-components/SecretTableRow.tsx:40]], and the same in `ContainerTableRow.tsx:39` and `OrderTableRow.tsx:38`. B.14 / Quick Reject: "Icon-only button without `aria-label`".
c1.fix: Add a matching `aria-label` next to `title` on all three toggles, as in `packages/aurora/src/client/routes/_auth/projects/$projectId/storage/-components/Ceph/Buckets/BucketHeaderActions.tsx:67`.

c3.issue: Create Order validation errors show as the user types instead of on blur / submit
c3.title: Create Order modal validates as-you-type
c3.explanation: Clearing the Algorithm or Bit Length field paints an error immediately, before the user has left the field. `algorithmError` and `bitLengthError` are derived from state on every render ([[at:packages/aurora/src/client/routes/_auth/projects/$projectId/authorization/key-manager/orders/-components/OrderModals.tsx:43]]) and passed straight to `errortext`, with no touched/blur tracking. B.11: validate on blur by default and re-validate on submit; as-you-type only for strict-format fields, which these aren't. The defaults are valid, so nothing shows before interaction.
c3.fix: Track touched fields and show the error only after blur or a submit attempt, as `packages/aurora/src/client/routes/_auth/projects/$projectId/compute/flavors/-components/CreateFlavorModal.tsx:225` does.

c11.issue: Container secret association (issue #1133 container Edit scope) was dropped with no scope note in the PR
c11.title: Container secret association is no longer delivered
c11.explanation: Users can't add or remove secrets in an existing container, which issue #1133 lists as the container Edit scope (`POST`/`DELETE /v1/containers/{id}/secrets`). This update removed `addContainerSecret` and `deleteContainerSecret` (fixing CR6), so the BFF covers list/get/create/delete for all three resources plus `updateSecret` and the payload query, but not container secret association. The PR body doesn't say this part is out of scope, so the acceptance criterion "tRPC BFF … for Secrets, Containers, and Orders" is only partly met.
c11.fix: Either reimplement association with the documented `POST /v1/containers/{id}/secrets` / `DELETE /v1/containers/{id}/secrets` (body with `secret_ref`), or state in the PR body that it's deferred and link a follow-up issue.
